records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Enterprise operating revenues increased $136.7 million, approximately 10%, in the third quarter of 2025 compared to the same quarter in 2024.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: •a $92.3 million increase in Truckload segment revenues (excluding fuel surcharge) due to Dedicated volume growth driven by the Cowan acquisition and increased Dedicated and Network rates;

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: In addition, we have a $250.0 million revolving credit facility maturing in November 2027 and a $200.0 million receivables purchase agreement maturing in May 2027, for which our combined available capacity as of September 30, 2025 was $276.9 million.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Operating expenses tend to be higher in the winter months, primarily due to colder weather, which causes higher maintenance expense and higher fuel consumption from increased idle time.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Enterprise net income decreased $11.2 million, approximately 37%, in the third quarter of 2025 compared to the same quarter in 2024, due to a $7.8 million decrease in income from operations and a $5.1 million increase in other expenses driven by increased interest expense, partially offset by a decrease in our provision for income taxes of $1.7 million.
